events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: After the deflection by Allen (CLE), the ball is last touched by Bridges' (CHA) right hand before going out of bounds. Possession should have been rewarded to CLE.
Green (CHA) reaches in and makes contact to Garland's (CLE) arm after he secures possession of the ball.
Hunter (CLE) initiates contact with Bridges' (CHA) arm after his gather, which affects Bridges' driving shot attempt.
Hunter (CLE) establishes himself in Baugh's (CHA) path, firms up and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs, as they come together during the pick.
Ball (CHA) brings his arm down and delivers contact to Garland's (CLE) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) jumps alongside Baugh's (CHA) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Nurkic (CHA) is retreating his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Hunter (CLE) during his shot attempt near the rim.
Hunter (CLE) is moving alongside Bridges' (CHA) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive. Bridges loses control of the ball on his own accord.
Bridges (CHA) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE).
Hunter (CLE) extends his left arm into Bridges' (CHA) body while he's airborne, and the contact dislodges him as he attempts to get to the inbounds pass.
Diabate (CHA) reaches in and makes contact with the ball that dislodges it away from Mitchell (CLE) prior to incidental arm contact occurring. A personal foul should not have been assessed.
Hunter (CLE) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Nurkic (CHA) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE).
Okoro (CLE) commits a take foul on Bridges (CHA).
Curry (CHA) commits a take foul on MItchell (CLE).
Mobley (CLE) legally contests Bridges' (CHA) jump shot attempt.
